items.title: A geometric point of an etale neighbourhood lifts to some member of any etale covering
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma says that for an etale covering {phi_i : U_i -> U} of an etale neighbourhood (U, ubar) of a geometric point sbar of S, some U_i carries a geometric point ubar_i over sbar making phi_i a morphism of etale neighbourhoods (statement lines 3306-3312). The proof converts surjectivity of the covering into nonemptyness of one fibre product, and then exploits the special shape of a scheme etale over an algebraically closed field: the fibre product is a disjoint union of finite separable extensions of k, which are all trivial because k is algebraically closed, so a section of pr_1 exists and composing it with pr_2 gives the lift (proof lines 3328-3337). The non-formal step is precisely that appeal to triviality of the field extensions, which is what makes the covering-surjectivity statement into a lifting statement for geometric points. The claim is H2.
